entries.wants: line under the title of the terminal interface's Settings screen: every setting Humanize keeps is here; a change to a daemon's or a workspace's setting is held until it is saved, while a theme or a language is kept as soon as it is chosen
entries.where: one or two short sentences with full stops, under the screen's title
entries.text: Every setting is here. A change to a daemon or workspace setting is held until saved, while a theme or language is kept as soon as it is chosen.

entries.wants: what the Themes page of Settings holds, for the terminal interface: the colours this terminal interface is drawn in (the web page's text is 'Colours and pictures of this browser’s page'; a terminal has no pictures and is no browser)
entries.where: one line under the page's name on its card, no full stop
entries.text: Colours of this terminal

entries.wants: what the Daemons page of Settings holds, for the terminal interface: the machines this terminal interface reaches (the web page's text is 'Machines this page reaches, and the one it shows'; the terminal interface is not a page)
entries.where: one line under the page's name on its card, no full stop
entries.text: Machines this terminal reaches, and the one it shows

entries.wants: what the Language page of Settings holds, for the terminal interface: what this terminal interface is written in (the web page's text is 'What this browser’s page is written in')
entries.where: one line under the page's name on its card, no full stop
entries.text: What this terminal is written in

entries.wants: how many of the kinds of notification are turned on: {n} of {total} on
entries.where: a few words at the far end of the Notifications card of Settings, lower case, keep {n} and {total}
entries.text: {n} of {total} on

entries.wants: a count of accounts: {n} accounts
entries.where: a few words at the far end of the Accounts card of Settings, lower case, keep {n}
entries.text: {n} accounts

entries.wants: a count of daemons: {n} daemons
entries.where: a few words at the far end of the Daemons card of Settings, lower case, keep {n}
entries.text: {n} daemons

entries.wants: a count of runtimes: {n} runtimes
entries.where: a few words at the far end of the Runtimes card of Settings, lower case, keep {n}
entries.text: {n} runtimes

entries.wants: a count of backup targets: {n} targets
entries.where: a few words at the far end of the Backup card of Settings, lower case, keep {n}
entries.text: {n} targets

entries.wants: a count of nous: {n} nous (nous is its own plural)
entries.where: a few words at the far end of the Nous card of Settings, lower case, keep {n}
entries.text: {n} nous

entries.wants: line under the title of the Themes page of the terminal interface: the theme under the cursor is shown as you move through the list and kept once chosen; Auto follows the terminal's background, light or dark
entries.where: one or two short sentences with full stops
entries.text: The theme under the cursor is shown as you move through the list and kept once chosen. Auto follows the terminal's background, light or dark.

entries.wants: what the appearance Auto means in a terminal: the light or dark side of the theme, whichever the terminal's background asks for
entries.where: a few words beside the row Auto on the Themes page, sentence case, no full stop
entries.text: Light or dark, whichever the terminal's background asks for

entries.wants: what the appearance Terminal means: drawn in the terminal's own sixteen colours on its own background, whatever theme is in use
entries.where: a few words beside the row Terminal on the Themes page, sentence case, no full stop
entries.text: The terminal's own sixteen colours on its own background, whatever theme is in use

entries.wants: line under the title of the Language page of the terminal interface: System follows the language this terminal is set to; what a daemon, a flow or an agent wrote stays as it was written (the web page's text is 'System follows the language this browser asks for. What a daemon, a flow or an agent wrote stays as it was written.')
entries.where: two short sentences with full stops
entries.text: System follows the language this terminal is set to. What a daemon, a flow or an agent wrote stays as it was written.

entries.wants: a note that the environment variable {name} is set and decides this instead of what is chosen on this page, for as long as it is set
entries.where: one short sentence under the list of a Settings page, keep {name}, with full stop
entries.text: {name} is set in the environment and decides this while it is set.

entries.wants: label of the setting that says what `$name` typed in a chat starts where a native skill of the harness and a flow share that name; its value is `native` or `flow`
entries.where: row label on the General page of Settings, a few words, sentence case, keep the `$` sign without backticks
entries.text: When $name is both

entries.wants: what that setting is: what $name starts in a chat where a native skill and a flow share the name
entries.where: one line under the row label, sentence case, no full stop, write $name without backticks
entries.text: What $name starts in a chat where a native skill and a flow share the name

entries.wants: what the value `native` of that setting means: the harness's own skill of that name runs
entries.where: a few words beside the value in a dropped-down list, sentence case, no full stop
entries.text: The harness's own skill of that name runs

entries.wants: what the value `flow` of that setting means: the flow of that name starts, and the skill stays `$` in the harness
entries.where: a few words beside the value in a dropped-down list, sentence case, no full stop, write $ without backticks
entries.text: The flow of that name starts, and the skill stays $ in the harness

entries.wants: what the setting Harness sessions does in the terminal interface: /resume in a chat lists the sessions each harness had of its own in this folder, to continue as chats
entries.where: one line under the row label, sentence case, no full stop, keep /resume as written without backticks
entries.text: /resume in a chat lists the sessions each harness had of its own in this folder, to continue as chats

entries.wants: label of the row that, opened, says what an error report includes and what it never includes
entries.where: row label on the General page of Settings, two or three words, sentence case
entries.text: What is sent

entries.wants: what that row is: what error reports include and what they leave out
entries.where: one line under the row label, sentence case, no full stop
entries.text: What error reports include and what they leave out

entries.wants: the two lists that row says once opened: what is sent, {sent}, and what is never sent, {kept}; each a list already written out
entries.where: two short sentences under the list of the General page, keep {sent} and {kept}, with full stops
entries.text: Sent: {sent}. Never sent: {kept}.

entries.wants: what the System switch of Notifications does in a terminal: the terminal shows a system notification while it is not the window in front, and rings its bell where it shows none
entries.where: one line under the row label System on the Notifications page, sentence case, no full stop
entries.text: Shows a system notification while the terminal is not in front, or rings the bell where it cannot

entries.wants: label of the workspace setting that is the agent a new chat in this folder talks to
entries.where: row label on the Workspace page of Settings, two words, sentence case
entries.text: Default agent

entries.wants: what that setting is: the agent a new chat in this folder talks to
entries.where: one line under the row label, sentence case, no full stop
entries.text: The agent a new chat in this folder talks to

entries.wants: when a held change lands: it takes effect the next time hmz is launched
entries.where: a few words beside a held setting, lower case, no full stop
entries.text: on next launch

entries.wants: when a held change lands: it takes effect in the next chat
entries.where: a few words beside a held setting, lower case, no full stop
entries.text: in the next chat

entries.wants: a setting called {name} could not be saved, and why: {why}
entries.where: one line in the transcript after Settings closes, keep {name} and {why}, no full stop
entries.text: Could not save {name}: {why}

entries.wants: the scope of the Usage page that is this folder alone, beside the page's own 'Every folder'
entries.where: a value in a dropped-down list, two words, sentence case
entries.text: This folder
